text:
1966 FIFA World Cup a wɔtoo wɔ England fi 11 kosi 30 July no yɛɛ mprɛnsa a wɔde too gua wɔ ɔman a wɔkasa English kasa mu. Akuo 16 na wɔde too mu, wɔkyekyɛɛ mu yɛɛ akuo anan a wɔn mu biara wɔ akuo anan. Akuo biara mu no, wɔde round-robin agorɔ na wɔgyee mu, na akuo abien a wɔdi kan no kɔɔ single-elimination knockout stage a ɛwɔ quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place match ne final mu.

North Korea na ɛyɛ ɔman foforɔ a ɛyɛ anigye paa, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ mprɛnsa a wɔbɛkɔɔ World Cup. Wɔtwaa Italy 1-0 wɔ group stage mu kɔɔ quarter-finals, na wɔkɔɔ anim kɔyɛɛ 3-0 wɔ Portugal so ansa na Eusebio de 5-3 comeback kɛseɛ bae. Eusebio yɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔyɛ anigye paa wɔ tournament no mu, na ɔwiee sɛ top scorer a ɔwɔ goals 9.

Final no wɔ Wembley Stadium wɔ London no hyiaa England ne West Germany wɔ nnipa 96,924 anim. Helmut Haller ne Wolfgang Weber nyaa goal ma West Germany, na Geoff Hurst ne Martin Peters nyaa goal ma England, na wɔyɛɛ 2-2 wɔ full time. Agorɔ no danee wɔ extra time mu: Hurst agorɔ no bɔɔ crossbar ase na ɛsanee fam wɔ line no nkyɛn. Swiss referee Gottfried Dienst de goal no mae wɔ Soviet linesman Tofik Bakhramov nkyerɛkyerɛ akyi, na West Germany twaa mu sɛ ɛnyɛ full line no. Hurst wiee ne hat-trick wɔ final minute no mu, ne goals 18', 101' ne 120' yɛɛ hat-trick koro a wɔanya wɔ men's World Cup final mu.

England dii 4-2 wɔ extra time akyi, na wɔfaa wɔn World Cup title a edi kan na wɔbɛyɛɛ ɔman a ɛdi kan a wɔadi nkunim wɔ 1934 Italy akyi. West Germany wiee sɛ runners-up, na Portugal faa third place wɔ Soviet Union a ɛwɔ fourth-place no anim. Wɔ tournament no nyinaa mu no, nnipa 1,563,135 na wɔbaa hɔ, na ɛyɛ 48,848 wɔ match biara mu.
